explanation: This tests vector-field flux integrals, absent from the supplied Linear Algebra topics, so it is prerequisite. The shown normal is clockwise from the tangent directed A to B. Flux is path-independent, so use the vertical segment x=2, 1≤y≤4. Since dx=0, the flux is ∫₁⁴−3√y dy=[−2y^(3/2)]₁⁴=−16+2=−14.
